limitations.text: This is a modern digital illustration of a received seal-script form, not a dated artifact image. Its use can illustrate the Shuowen analysis but cannot prove the graph’s early physical form or chronology.
The direct Xiaoxuetang 看 record was not accessible, so no Sinica-sourced glyph is proposed. The exact Commons image itself could not be pixel-inspected with the available web tool.
